acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for seeing significant AEO results can vary, but generally, you can expect to see initial improvements within 3 to 6 months. This timeframe allows for search engines to recrawl and reindex your optimized content, recognize its relevance to specific queries, and begin featuring it in answer boxes or snippets. Factors influencing this include the competitiveness of your local market, the quality and consistency of your optimization efforts, and the existing authority of your website. Continuous monitoring and refinement are essential for sustained success and improving your visibility over time.
